description: Pre-loaded RVT demos (VW1-22 / M6-03) for the rvt-view browser viewer. Real-project entries are MIT-licensed samples from magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets, staged from the _project_corpus/ checkout and hash-verified. Tier-1 entries are redistributable synthetic CFB fixtures from corpus/tier1/. Optional phi-ag family RFAs stage when the LFS corpus is present.
attribution: Real projects: magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets (MIT). Tier-1 synthetics and reference IFC fixtures: rvt-rs (Apache-2.0, generated by gen-fixture). Optional family RFAs: phi-ag/rvt sample LICENSE when staged.
license: Redistributable samples only; every staged file ships with a .license.json sidecar.

demos.name: Einhoven (Revit 2023, real project)
demos.description: Real Revit 2023 project from magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets (MIT). Decodes 24/24 ArcWalls with bodies across four elevation-derived storeys plus 42 materials; floors, doors, windows and rooms remain open on this file. This is the file the CI browser regression gates.
demos.expected_quality_note: Real-project wall geometry (decoder baseline in tests/fixtures/project-counts/revit-ifc5-einhoven.json). Not a full typed model: no floors, doors, windows or rooms yet.

demos.name: Core Interior (Revit 2024, real project)
demos.description: Real Revit 2024 project from magnetar-io/revit-test-datasets (MIT). Partition element records reproduce Revit's own exported ElementId sets exactly: 360 walls, 132 doors, 6 windows, 256 columns, 80 slabs and 20 shading devices across 15 levels (RE-21 to RE-26). 32 MB download; decode takes a moment.
demos.expected_quality_note: Cross-witness gated element sets with bodies (tests/fixtures/project-counts/2024-core-interior.json). Rooms and materials are known gaps.

demos.name: Architectural 2024 (tier1)
demos.description: Redistributable architectural synthetic: Level, Wall, Floor, Door, Window (5 each). Opens cleanly; expect scaffold ~25% export confidence — typed real-project extraction is unsolved.
demos.expected_quality_note: Scaffold ~25% is expected for tier1 synthetics. Useful for File status, confidence, and export buttons — not validated walls/doors/levels.

demos.name: Structural 2023 (tier1)
demos.description: Redistributable structural synthetic: Level, Wall, Floor, Column, Beam. Scaffold-only decode is expected.
demos.expected_quality_note: Scaffold confidence is expected. Not a claim of typed structural geometry from real projects.

demos.name: MEP 2024 (tier1)
demos.description: Redistributable MEP-leaning synthetic: Level, Wall, Door, Window, Duct. Scaffold-only decode is expected.
demos.expected_quality_note: Scaffold confidence is expected. MEP typed recovery from arbitrary real projects is not claimed.

demos.name: Synthetic MVP fixture (2024)
demos.description: License-free CFB fixture from gen-fixture — fallback when corpus/tier1 is unavailable. Same scaffold expectations as architectural-2024.
demos.expected_quality_note: Partial / scaffold export (~25%). Useful for status, diagnostics, and export buttons — not full walls/doors/levels.
demos.provenance: Generated at build time by viewer/scripts/stage-demos.mjs via gen-fixture.

demos.name: RAC Basic Sample Family (2024)
demos.description: Family-scale sample — the canonical reference across every rvt-rs test. Optional; staged only when the phi-ag LFS corpus is present.
demos.expected_quality_note: Honest partial decode: metadata/schema and spatial scaffold; typed project geometry is not claimed.

demos.name: RAC Basic Sample Family (2026)
demos.description: Same family upgraded through every Revit release — shows cross-version reading. Optional corpus.
demos.expected_quality_note: Honest partial decode: metadata/schema and spatial scaffold; typed project geometry is not claimed.

demos.name: Synthetic IFC project fixture
demos.description: Hand-built IFC4 fixture — shows what the exporter produces without a Revit input. Not opened by the RVT parser; download/reference only.
demos.expected_quality_note: Reference IFC4 with typed elements from synthesized inputs. Viewer cannot parse IFC as input.

demos.name: Synthetic structural fixture
demos.description: Columns + beams + structural framing — exercises the IfcMember routing + RepresentationMap paths. Download/reference only.
demos.expected_quality_note: Reference IFC4 structural sample. Viewer cannot parse IFC as input.

schema_note: Frontend loader reads the staged catalog at /demos/catalog.json (written by viewer/scripts/stage-demos.mjs), copies redistributable binaries to /demos/, and renders a gallery with provenance + expected quality labels. The element_count_hint is a display value — the actual viewer runs its own element enumeration on load.
privacy_note: Every demo listed here has redistribution rights confirmed. Demo bytes are same-origin static assets fetched only when the user clicks a gallery entry (or during initial catalog load). Adding a new demo requires either (a) the contributor holds copyright and chooses to open-source it, or (b) the file is already under an open license allowing redistribution (e.g. phi-ag/rvt's MIT / sample-content clause). See docs/viewer-privacy-posture.md (VW1-21) for the broader client-side-only posture.
